about: The balcony door as the game runs it at the start of the balcony beat: the director opens it as the black lifts off the player at the railing, and the glass leaf slides 1.4 m along the inside of the wall at the game's door speed (the doorway's width in 1.2 s), then stands open for the rest of the prologue. Played once from the stage's start; the scene record already stands the leaf open (its `moved`), so the slide starts 1.4 m back, shut. The game plays no sound with it. The flat's front door is an open doorway in the game and never moves. Frame: EarthSite's, 9 m down (data/scene/flat.json).
